generic_domain.justification: Meta-learning is a broad research area that encompasses various methods and applications of learning how to learn. The other domains listed, such as meta-reinforcement learning and online meta-learning, are specific subsets within the broader meta-learning framework. Meta-reinforcement learning applies meta-learning principles specifically to reinforcement learning scenarios, while online meta-learning focuses on applying meta-learning in an online or incremental setting. Therefore, meta-learning serves as the most comprehensive and encompassing domain that includes these specialized areas.
